subject: Request: partner-funded trial top-up for CloudForge SI onboarding
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@cloudforge.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: partner-funded trial top-up for AeroDynamics PoC

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the intro last week. Quick ask: AeroDynamics (the prospect we demoed with) would like a 45‑day extension and an additional $4,000 promotional allocation routed via the CloudForge marketplace so they can complete an extended PoC that includes our telemetry integration.

Why we need it: the initial 14‑day trial exhausted during integration testing and AeroDynamics wants to validate LLM cost/latency at higher token volumes before committing. I can commit to a go/no‑go decision 30 days into the extended period.

What I need from Redwood:
- Approval for a 45‑day trial extension
- Marketplace promo code (or partner credit allocation) for $4,000 tied to AeroDynamics deal CF-4287-PILOT
- Any minimal paperwork to reflect the promo routing through CloudForge

I attached the PoC scope and expected usage numbers. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks —
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge
S: 415‑555‑0198

[Attachment: pilot_scope_aerodynamics.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: partner-funded trial top-up for AeroDynamics PoC

Team — forwarding a request from our CloudForge partner for a 45‑day extension + $4k promotional allocation to be routed via their marketplace. AeroDynamics is on the cusp of committing but needs additional runway to finish integration.

Questions for ops/legal/partnerships:
- Aditya: can we do $4k partner-provided credit routed through marketplace for this kind of PoC? Any BOM/PR required?
- Vanessa: if ops approves, can partnerships issue a partner allocation and maintain tracking against CF-4287-PILOT?
- Alex: will this require any extra support from Solutions (we may need a short onboarding session once the extension goes live)?

Samantha attached the PoC scope. She’s cc'd Alex originally; I added Laura to flag contract/PO questions.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | (650) 555‑2032

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: partner-funded trial top-up for AeroDynamics PoC

Stephanie / team —

We can support a partner‑sourced promotional allocation for this PoC. Proposed approach:
- Issue a $4,000 marketplace credit code tied to CloudForge partner account (CF‑promo‑4287)
- Extend the trial window to 60 days (45 is fine but 60 gives buffer for integration delays)
- Require a simple promo allocation form and a signed acknowledgment from the customer (no contract amendment needed)

I attached the promo allocation form and a stub MOP for bookkeeping. If legal needs to review the wording, loop them in but this is standard for partner‑routed pilots.

Next steps I need from Stephanie / CloudForge:
1) Confirmation that AeroDynamics accepts a 60‑day extension and the $4k allocation process.
2) Signed promo_allocation_form.pdf returned to go live.

I’ll hold off issuing the code until the signed form is returned.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: partner-funded trial top-up for AeroDynamics PoC

+1 from Partnerships.

Operational notes:
- We’ll issue the marketplace credit once promo_allocation_form.pdf is returned with the customer signature.
- I recommend we set expire_at = 2027-01-01 to give AeroDynamics flexibility, and mark usage monitoring on the deal in HubSpot (HS-4271).
- I’ll add a short onboarding session from Solutions (Alex) to the calendar for the first week after the extension goes live so they can validate telemetry ingestion.

Attaching the marketplace integration checklist so CloudForge can confirm the route for credit redemption on their side.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: partner-funded trial top-up for AeroDynamics PoC

Thanks everyone — AeroDynamics has signed the attached form and confirmed they accept the 60‑day extension and $4k allocation.

I’ve attached the signed promo_allocation_form.pdf and a short note from AeroDynamics contact (contact@aerodynamics.com) confirming timeline. Please issue the CF‑promo‑4287 code and send redemption instructions; we’ll coordinate the onboarding session with Alex for next Tuesday.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this should get the PoC past the final test phase.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
CloudForge
